label: native
method: Full bead contact recheck of all v2 half-bead flags: previous segment centerlines are buffered by (previous_width+current_width)/2 +0.01 mm. This identifies runs whose deposited bead has no overlap with preceding printed material. Paths lying entirely within the previous model solid are separately retained as internal infill gaps, not mislabeled as missing external fins. All original v2 flags remain available.

islands.classification_basis: Exact deposited bead region, including any holes; rectangular bounding-box coverage is retained only as diagnostic.
